name: agenai-agent-sdk
description: Provider-neutral TypeScript contracts for hosting coding agents.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @agen-ai/validation build && pnpm --filter @agen-ai/agent-protocol build && pnpm --filter @agen-ai/agent-runtime build && pnpm --filter @agen-ai/agent-orchestration build && pnpm --filter @agen-ai/acp-transport build && pnpm --filter @agen-ai/provider-acp build && pnpm --filter @agen-ai/acp-registry build
scripts.check: pnpm check:repository && pnpm test:release && pnpm check:generated && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck:packages && pnpm test:examples && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:external-consumer
scripts.check:generated: pnpm --filter @agen-ai/agent-protocol check:contracts && pnpm --filter @agen-ai/agent-protocol check:json-schema && pnpm --filter @agen-ai/acp-transport check:generated
scripts.test: pnpm test:release && pnpm build && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:examples && pnpm test:external-consumer
scripts.test:examples: pnpm typecheck:examples && pnpm examples:local && pnpm examples:live-request-output && pnpm examples:lifecycle-interactions && pnpm examples:session-continuations && pnpm examples:session-continuations:acp && pnpm examples:remembered-approvals && pnpm examples:remembered-approvals:acp && pnpm examples:registry && pnpm examples:delegation && pnpm examples:delegation:acp && pnpm test:examples:native
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @agen-ai/validation test && pnpm --filter @agen-ai/agent-protocol test && pnpm --filter @agen-ai/agent-runtime test && pnpm --filter @agen-ai/agent-orchestration test && pnpm --filter @agen-ai/acp-transport test && pnpm --filter @agen-ai/provider-acp test && pnpm --filter @agen-ai/acp-registry test
scripts.typecheck:packages: pnpm --filter @agen-ai/validation typecheck && pnpm --filter @agen-ai/agent-protocol typecheck && pnpm --filter @agen-ai/agent-runtime typecheck && pnpm --filter @agen-ai/agent-orchestration typecheck && pnpm --filter @agen-ai/acp-transport typecheck && pnpm --filter @agen-ai/provider-acp typecheck && pnpm --filter @agen-ai/acp-registry typecheck
